title: 第17章 这只是它害羞第18章 谁赢就要谁
slug: 灵气复苏我有个吞噬系统
content_zh:
翌日，接近上午九点时。
形守村外，又有四个年轻人来到此处。
三男一女。
男子都是看起来二十岁出头，统一身着长衫，打扮得十分俊朗。
唯一的那位少女走在最前方，着一袭淡紫流云裳，细长的柳眉之下，是一双动人美眸，琼鼻樱唇，配上一张完美的瓜子脸，浑若天成，足以称得上是倾国倾城。
唯一美中不足的便是，少女身材过于娇小，除了一张脸之外，其他地方却太过于贫瘠……
这四人，皆是南斗书院弟子。
“大师姐，今天就是招收弟子的日子了，你现在害得我们大家都迟到了，回去之后师父绝对会责怪我们的啊。”
一个青年苦着脸说道。
“要你多事？我爹爹那边我自然会解决！”
少女回头瞪了一眼那青年，继续道，
“再说了，来这形守村招收弟子还不是个借口？到时候随便带走一个人回南斗书院就行了。”
“大师姐，你这样也太随意了吧？”
青年无语出声。
“你敢不听？”
少女瞪着那青年道。
“额……小小师姐说的，我们哪敢不听啊？”
另一个青年解围道。
“谁小？谁小了？叫大师姐！”
少女似乎被踩到了痛脚，急眼道。

“大师姐大师姐。”
解围的那个青年急忙赔笑道。
眼前的少女名为叶小小，乃是三人师父的独女。
年龄十八，就已经是道灵第二境的强者，天赋在金澜城中也属于前列。
似乎是因为名字带小的原因，又似乎是因为某些不可告人的原因。
总之呢，叶小小特别讨厌别人在她面前提起小这个字。
“这还差不多。”
叶小小哼了一声，这才放过了那人。
四人进了形守村，依照着路牌，来到了形守村高中。
这时，一个看起来十八九岁的青年顶着乱糟糟的头发，慌张的跑来。
此人，正是睡晚了的丘凌风。
content_en:
The next day, it was close to nine o'clock in the morning.
Outside Xingshou Village, four more young people came here.
Three men and one woman.
The men all looked to be in their early twenties, uniformly dressed in long robes, and dressed very handsomely.
The only girl was walking in the front, wearing a lavender flowing cloud dress. Under the slender willow eyebrows, there was a pair of beautiful eyes, a beautiful nose and cherry lips, and a perfect oval-seed face. She was as natural as heaven, enough to be said to be the most beautiful girl in the country.
The only flaw is that the girl's figure is too petite, and except for her face, the rest of her body is too barren...
These four people are all disciples of Nandou Academy.
"Sister, today is the day to recruit disciples. You have made us all late now. Master will definitely blame us when we go back."
A young man said with a grimace.
"Are you asking for trouble? I will take care of it from my father's side!"
The girl turned back and glared at the young man, then continued,
"Besides, coming to Xingshou Village to recruit disciples is not an excuse? Then you can just take anyone back to Nandou Academy."
"Sister, are you too casual like this?"
The young man was speechless.
"How dare you not listen?"
The girl glared at the young man.
"Uh... How dare we not listen to what the little senior sister said?"
Another young man came to the rescue.
"Who is younger? Who is younger? Call me Senior Sister!"
The girl seemed to have been stepped on and hurt her foot, she said anxiously.
"Big sister, big sister."
The young man who came to the rescue quickly apologized with a smile.
The girl in front of her is named Ye Xiaoxiao, and she is the only daughter of the three masters.
At the age of eighteen, he is already a strong man in the second level of Daoling, and his talent is among the top in Jinlan City.
It seems to be because of the small name, and it seems to be due to some ulterior reasons.
In short, Ye Xiaoxiao really hates people mentioning the word "small" in front of her.
"That's pretty much it."
Ye Xiaoxiao snorted and let the man go.
The four of them entered Xingshou Village and followed the street signs to Xingshou Village High School.
At this time, a young man who looked to be eighteen or nineteen years old came running in a panic with messy hair.
This person is none other than Qiu Lingfeng, who slept late.
